pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of duplicate ticket clustering within a 1.00 USD price radius on XAUUSD; maximum of 1 active position per directional node until the prior ticket hits breakeven plus 1R.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR(14) expansion filter combined with order book imbalance check: entries are strictly blocked if spread exceeds 35 pips or during the 15-minute window before/after high-impact macro data releases.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop locking at +$4.00 profit, with mechanical scale-out triggers scaling at +$10.00 and full structural harvest at +$25.00+.
